<script>
function filterHub(query) {
  const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  
  // Filter table rows
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#hub-master-table tbody tr');
  rows.forEach(row => {
    const text = (row.getAttribute('data-guest') + ' ' + row.innerText).toLowerCase();
    row.style.display = text.includes(q) ? '' : 'none';
  });

  // Filter cards
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#hub-cards-container article');
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const text = (card.getAttribute('data-card-guest') + ' ' + card.innerText).toLowerCase();
    card.style.display = text.includes(q) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

function setFilter(type, btn) {
  // Update active pill button
  document.querySelectorAll('#hub-filter-pills .hub-pill-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');

  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#hub-master-table tbody tr');
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#hub-cards-container article');

  rows.forEach(row => {
    if (type === 'all') {
      row.style.display = '';
    } else {
      const status = row.getAttribute('data-status');
      row.style.display = (status === type) ? '' : 'none';
    }
  });

  cards.forEach(card => {
    if (type === 'all') {
      card.style.display = '';
    } else {
      const status = card.getAttribute('data-card-status');
      card.style.display = (status === type) ? '' : 'none';
    }
  });
}
</script>
